thread.title: American Airlines to offer Apple Music for free to in-flight customers

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: American Airlines to offer Apple Music for free to in-flight customers
text: American Airlines Group Inc. AAL, +0.22% said Wednesday that it will start giving its in-flight customers free access to Apple Inc.'s AAPL, +5.08% music service, Apple Music, on domestic flights, starting Feb. 1. The service will give customers exclusive access to Apple Music's more than 50 million songs, playlists and music videos. "Our customers want to make the most of their time when flying with us," said Janelle Anderson, vice president of global marketing at American Airlines. "That's why we're investing in high-speed Wi-Fi, the newest movies, live TV and now Apple Music." American's stock edged up 0.1% in premarket trade, while Apple's stock surged 4.7% after fiscal first-quarter results out late Tuesday. American shares have tumbled 31% over the past 12 months, while the NYSE Arca Airline Index XAL, -0.39% has lost 13% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +1.12% has slipped 5.7%.
